subject: Credit note for invoice INV-2526-01431
body:
Dear Delta Traders Private Limited team,

We have reviewed invoice INV-2526-01431 dated 25 Sep 2025 and identified that HSN 8528 was charged at 28 percent instead of the applicable 18 percent rate effective from 22 Sep 2025. Consequently, an excess tax of Rs 21,436 was applied.

We will issue a credit note for Rs 21,436 and provide a corrected invoice. Please update your records accordingly.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
GSTIN 07AAACS1234F1ZU
